segments_b.text: I am the keeper of the gate, a seer of the way, a sculptor of the spirit molding futures out to play
These hands, though rough, were crafted to create, with a mind unbound, designed to elevate
A spiritual woman, oh yes, she's a threat to the status quo, for the fruit she bears
The power she knows, is deeper than most can never forget
She a healer, she a flame, she a vision in the dark
Rude so deep, she be movin' through the ox
Spiritual woman, rise and reclaim, break all the chains
Call on the name, spiritual woman
Power so true, bearer of life, bring the world into full
A spiritual woman is the greatest threat
To the status quo, don't you forget
The fruit she will bear, the strength she holds, a force of creation
